label: D1 reward cue, mostly after a rewarded visit to S2 (habituates over reward streaks)
explanation: Fires only at D1 (100% of mass) and almost only when the reward input is 1 (98.8% of mass; ~0 at GO/D2 or after unrewarded trials). Among rewarded D1 steps it strongly prefers the previous trial having reached S2 (prev_state==2; prev_state is unknown inside the window on its first trial, hence != 1). All variables are observed. Dev: P 0.37, R 0.97, F1 0.53, mass recall 0.985 (in_rew==1 alone: P 0.22, R 0.98). Magnitude is largest on the first reward after an unrewarded trial and decays over consecutive rewards (e.g. 1.0, 0.64, 0.36, 0.19 along a streak), and it is higher early in the episode (rate 0.10 in trials 0-19 vs 0.02 in 90-99). Most false positives are D1 steps deep in long S2 reward streaks, where the feature has habituated to zero. Excluding steps after 2 prior rewards gives F1 0.56 / mass 0.93, a small gain, so the simpler predicate is recorded. A reward-surprise / S2-reward signal that the predicate captures only as a binary.
